lines.text: Our God is a God of deliverance;
the Lord GOD is our rescuer from death.
Surely God will crush the heads of His enemies,
the hairy crowns of those who persist in guilty ways.
The Lord said, “I will retrieve them from Bashan,
I will bring them up from the depths of the sea,
that your foot may be dipped
in the blood of your foes—
the tongues of your dogs in the same.”
They have seen Your procession, O God—
the march of my God and King into the sanctuary.
Bless God in the great congregation;
bless the LORD from the fountain of Israel.

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, The Raising of Lazarus — the dead man rising in the tomb at the lifted hand, our God is a God of deliverance, the Lord GOD is our rescuer from death
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_raising_of_lazarus

pictures.scene: François Gérard, La bataille d'Austerlitz — the broken army going down under the charge across the field, surely God will crush the heads of His enemies, the hairy crowns of those who persist in guilty ways
pictures.name: pd_gerard_austerlitz

pictures.scene: Winslow Homer, The Herring Net — the two fishermen hauling the loaded net up out of the swell, I will retrieve them from Bashan, I will bring them up from the depths of the sea
pictures.name: pd_homer_the_herring_net

pictures.scene: Jacob van Ruisdael, The Jewish Cemetery — the tombs standing among the ruins under the broken storm light, that your foot may be dipped in the blood of your foes
pictures.name: pd_ruisdael_jewish_cemetery

pictures.scene: Gentile Bellini, Processione in piazza San Marco — the long line of singers and brethren carrying the relic across the square before the church, the tongues of your dogs in the same, they have seen Your procession O God
pictures.name: pd_bellini_procession_piazza_san_marco

pictures.scene: Anthony van Dyck, The Entry of Christ into Jerusalem — the King riding in on the donkey through the crowd spreading their clothes in the road, the march of my God and King into the sanctuary, the singers lead the way
pictures.name: pd_van_dyck_entry_into_jerusalem

pictures.scene: Gerard van Honthorst, The Concert — the players gathered close around the music with the cittern sounding, the musicians follow after, among the maidens playing tambourines
pictures.name: pd_honthorst_the_concert

pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, The Sermon of Saint John the Baptist — the whole countryside crowded into the wood to hear the preacher, bless God in the great congregation, bless the LORD from the fountain of Israel
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_sermon_of_john_the_baptist
